purpose: Turn the owner-supplied PDFs into a compact implementation packet for Shire/Hobbiton/Bag End so programmers do not need to reread the entire corpus for routine production decisions.

precedence: SCRIPT_VERIFIED / supplied screenplay for scene order and participant facts where recognized by the Source Rules.
FILM_CANON and project master summaries below screenplay authority.
Production-design bibles guide visual/implementation language but cannot override higher canon.
VISUAL_ONLY references never define canon facts.
External resource providers never define canon.
source_rules.implementation_rule: If two sources conflict, prefer the higher source priority and mark unresolved conflicts instead of blending them.

SHIRE_HOBBITON.visual_grammar: Warm domestic scale; circular doors; gardens
production_rules: Partition streaming by sightline/portal/terrain logic and preload the next critical area.
NPC population, schedules, dialogue knowledge and faction presence are chapter-state data.
Test backtracking, reload, collision, navmesh and chapter-state swaps.

BAG_END.gameplay_role: Narrative hub, inventory tutorial, Ring revelation
production_rules: Preload next critical area before transition.
Preserve the interior as a lived-in narrative hub rather than an empty shell.

ownership: SourceAssets are raw/reference sources and shipping maps do not directly reference them.
Production world assets belong in the game/world content structure.
Stable IDs and data-driven state are preferred over fragile object references.
profiling: CPU review includes AI counts, animation ticking, collision, spawning, pathfinding and crowd logic.
GPU review includes shadows, foliage overdraw, translucency, expensive materials and skeletal cost.
Memory review includes textures, duplicate materials, skeletal meshes, animation sets, audio and persistent sublevels.
Streaming should avoid large synchronous world transitions.

material_resource_requirements.provenance_rule: Retain source/provider/license metadata even for open/CC0 assets.

visual_reference_boundary.rule: Use for modeling/material study only; do not infer story/canon from the atlas.

immediate_asset_targets: support props for lived-in interior density
evidence_boundary: Source extraction for implementation planning only; no runtime/visual acceptance claim.
